## Repair pass on the digest rework: fix _run_git call shapes and bytes decoding… — 2026-07-25 (parent 20f06c021ab3)

Digest storage is redesigned from a single prepend-only `TRIE_DIFF.md` to one immutable file per commit under a `triediffs/` directory, with `TRIE_DIFF.md` becoming a relative symlink atomically repointed after each write (falling back to a regular file on filesystems that don't support symlinks). `write_digest` replaces `upsert_digest`, adding:

- `_new_digest_filename` generating `<utc-timestamp>-<uuid4-hex>.md` for lexicographic/chronological ordering
- in-place rewrite for same-commit retries via the cursor's new `file` field
- mtime-ordered retention pruning to `diff.max_entries`

`Diff` config gains `d
